title: Even a's and even b's: already minimal
notes: Each state remembers whether the a's and the b's so far are even. Round 1 tells all four apart, round 2 changes nothing, and all four states stay.
ops: start q0; accept q0; q0 a -> q1; q0 b -> q2; q1 a -> q0; q1 b -> q3; q2 a -> q3; q2 b -> q0; q3 a -> q2; q3 b -> q1
